answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing escrowed jobs whose outcomes are verified by randomly assigned, stake-backed reviewers. A reviewer who approves a fabricated result loses part of its deposit when later evidence or a dispute exposes the fraud; honest reviewers share the penalty. This makes a Sybil ring pay to fund many identities and lock capital in each, while risking correlated losses if its members collude. The haven, basalt, and dune projects can all use the same rule without trusting names alone.
